neet_phy_u19_t01_1.working: In reverse bias, majority-carrier flow is blocked by the raised barrier. Only thermally generated minority carriers drift across the junction, giving the small saturation current.

neet_phy_u19_t01_4.working: Forward current is due to majority carriers (A-II). Reverse saturation current is due to minority carriers (B-III). The depletion region has immobile ions and no free carriers (C-I). Its field points from the n side to the p side (D-IV).

neet_phy_u19_t01_5.working: A is true: forward bias lowers the barrier and narrows the depletion region. B is false: below breakdown the saturation current is nearly independent of reverse voltage. C is true: saturation current rises with temperature. D is false: a diode is non-ohmic. E is true: at equilibrium diffusion and drift currents balance.
